module.name: Supplier Quality & Performance Module
module.description: Comprehensive tracking of supplier quality metrics, defect rates, on-time delivery, lead time performance, compliance certifications (ISO, FDA, etc.), audit scores, customer complaints, returns, and quality improvement trends. Integrates internal performance data with third-party audit reports.
module.expansion_logic: Quality parameters tracked per supplier, per product category, per facility. With 500,000+ suppliers and 50+ product categories, historical performance tracked over 12-60 months with rolling averages and trend analysis.
data_sources: Third-party quality auditors (SGS, Bureau Veritas, Intertek)

parameters.name: supplier_defect_rate_ppm
parameters.purpose: Defect rate in parts per million (PPM) based on historical shipments.

parameters.name: supplier_defect_rate_ppm_12m_rolling
parameters.purpose: 12-month rolling average defect rate.

parameters.name: supplier_defect_rate_trend
parameters.purpose: Defect rate trend: 'improving', 'stable', 'worsening'.

parameters.name: supplier_critical_defects_count_12m
parameters.purpose: Number of critical defects (safety, compliance) in last 12 months.

parameters.name: supplier_major_defects_count_12m
parameters.purpose: Number of major defects (functionality, performance) in last 12 months.

parameters.name: supplier_minor_defects_count_12m
parameters.purpose: Number of minor defects (cosmetic, documentation) in last 12 months.

parameters.name: supplier_first_pass_yield_percent
parameters.purpose: First Pass Yield percentage (products that pass inspection first time).

parameters.name: supplier_inspection_rejection_rate_percent
parameters.purpose: Percentage of shipments rejected during receiving inspection.

parameters.name: supplier_return_rate_percent
parameters.purpose: Percentage of products returned by customers (end-user returns).

parameters.name: supplier_warranty_claim_rate_percent
parameters.purpose: Percentage of products with warranty claims.

parameters.name: supplier_customer_complaint_count_12m
parameters.purpose: Number of customer complaints related to supplier's products in last 12 months.

parameters.name: supplier_corrective_action_requests_open
parameters.purpose: Number of open Corrective Action Requests (CARs) with supplier.

parameters.name: supplier_corrective_action_response_time_avg_days
parameters.purpose: Average days for supplier to respond to CARs.

parameters.name: supplier_on_time_delivery_rate_percent
parameters.purpose: Percentage of orders delivered on time (within tolerance window).

parameters.name: supplier_on_time_delivery_rate_12m_rolling
parameters.purpose: 12-month rolling average on-time delivery rate.

parameters.name: supplier_avg_delivery_delay_days
parameters.purpose: Average delivery delay in days (for late deliveries).

parameters.name: supplier_max_delivery_delay_days_12m
parameters.purpose: Maximum delivery delay in last 12 months.

parameters.name: supplier_order_fulfillment_rate_percent
parameters.purpose: Percentage of orders fulfilled completely (no short shipments).

parameters.name: supplier_partial_shipment_rate_percent
parameters.purpose: Percentage of orders with partial shipments.

parameters.name: supplier_lead_time_quoted_avg_days
parameters.purpose: Average lead time quoted by supplier in days.

parameters.name: supplier_lead_time_actual_avg_days
parameters.purpose: Average actual lead time delivered by supplier in days.

parameters.name: supplier_lead_time_variance_days
parameters.purpose: Variance (actual - quoted) lead time in days.

parameters.name: supplier_lead_time_reliability_score
parameters.purpose: 0-100 reliability score for lead time consistency.

parameters.name: supplier_capacity_utilization_percent
parameters.purpose: Supplier's capacity utilization percentage (if known).

parameters.name: supplier_production_capacity_annual_units
parameters.purpose: Annual production capacity in units.

parameters.name: supplier_min_order_quantity_moq
parameters.purpose: Minimum order quantity required by supplier.

parameters.name: supplier_iso_9001_certified_flag
parameters.purpose: Boolean: whether supplier is ISO 9001 (Quality Management) certified.

parameters.name: supplier_iso_14001_certified_flag
parameters.purpose: Boolean: whether supplier is ISO 14001 (Environmental Management) certified.

parameters.name: supplier_iso_45001_certified_flag
parameters.purpose: Boolean: whether supplier is ISO 45001 (Occupational Health & Safety) certified.

parameters.name: supplier_iatf_16949_certified_flag
parameters.purpose: Boolean: whether supplier is IATF 16949 (Automotive Quality) certified.

parameters.name: supplier_as9100_certified_flag
parameters.purpose: Boolean: whether supplier is AS9100 (Aerospace Quality) certified.

parameters.name: supplier_fda_registered_flag
parameters.purpose: Boolean: whether supplier facility is FDA registered.

parameters.name: supplier_fda_inspection_count_last_5y
parameters.purpose: Number of FDA inspections in last 5 years.

parameters.name: supplier_fda_warning_letters_count_last_5y
parameters.purpose: Number of FDA warning letters received in last 5 years.

parameters.name: supplier_fda_483_observations_count_last_inspection
parameters.purpose: Number of FDA Form 483 observations in last inspection.

parameters.name: supplier_gmp_good_manufacturing_practice_certified_flag
parameters.purpose: Boolean: whether supplier is GMP certified.

parameters.name: supplier_audit_score_latest
parameters.purpose: Latest audit score (0-100) from third-party or internal audit.

parameters.name: supplier_audit_score_avg_3y
parameters.purpose: Average audit score over last 3 years.

parameters.name: supplier_audit_score_trend
parameters.purpose: Audit score trend: 'improving', 'stable', 'declining'.

parameters.name: supplier_audit_critical_findings_count_latest
parameters.purpose: Number of critical findings in latest audit.

parameters.name: supplier_audit_major_findings_count_latest
parameters.purpose: Number of major findings in latest audit.

parameters.name: supplier_composite_quality_score
parameters.purpose: 0-100 composite quality score (defects, returns, complaints, audits).

parameters.name: supplier_composite_delivery_score
parameters.purpose: 0-100 composite delivery performance score (OTD, lead time, fulfillment).

parameters.name: supplier_overall_performance_score
parameters.purpose: 0-100 overall supplier performance score (quality + delivery + responsiveness).

parameters.name: supplier_performance_tier
parameters.purpose: Performance tier: 'platinum', 'gold', 'silver', 'bronze', 'at_risk'.
